snippet.title: Harem of Ankhutep Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Harem of Ankhutep is a visual novel that blends monstergirls, romance, egypt and comfy slice-of-life. Set in the sun-drenched streets of Ankhutep, an ancient desert city where daily life unfolds in the shadow of gods, and monstergirls walk the same streets as everyone else as a natural part of everyday life. You, the player, begin your journey by escaping an attack on your homeland, and you arrive in Ankhutep to begin again, not as a warrior or a ruler, but as a humble craftsman.
Join the discord: https://discord.gg/uuf95CsKNj
